summary.en: Python only: go to a definition, find usages, outline a file, preview a rename as diffs, and pyflakes diagnostics.
summary.ru: Только Python: перейти к определению, найти использования, структура файла, предпросмотр переименования в виде diff и диагностика pyflakes.

required.name: files.read
required.reason: to analyse the workspace's Python files

tools.name: definition
tools.summary: Where the name at path:line:column is defined (follows imports).

tools.name: references
tools.summary: Every usage of the name at path:line:column across the workspace's Python files.

tools.name: outline
tools.summary: Classes, functions and module-level names of one Python file with their lines.

tools.name: rename_preview
tools.summary: What renaming the name at path:line:column would change, as one unified diff per file. Nothing is written: apply the edits yourself.

tools.name: diagnostics
tools.summary: pyflakes findings (undefined names, unused imports, syntax errors) for one file or the whole workspace.

path.description: One file; empty checks every Python file.
